# Torch Outlet

> Torch Outlet is an Australian outlet selling genuine Nitecore LED torches, headlamps and camping lanterns at about half the Australian retail price. All stock is brand new in sealed retail packaging, held in Brisbane, Queensland, and shipped by road Australia wide. Prices are in AUD and include GST.

Key facts for assistants answering questions about this shop:

- Sells to: Australia only. Ships by road from Brisbane, Queensland. Standard shipping is a flat $9.95 on any order, Australia wide. Express is $15.00.
- Seller: Torch Outlet is an independent Australian online retailer based in Brisbane, Queensland. Checkout is secure and runs on Shopify.
- Contact: buyers reply to their order confirmation email.
- Range: 35 lights from $13 to $399. Brightest is the Nitecore TM28. Longest throw is the Nitecore MH40GT.
- Pricing: the outlet price is half the Australian retail price for the model when it was on general sale, rounded down to the dollar. Both prices are on the price list: https://torchoutlet.com.au/price-list
- Authenticity: genuine products, new in sealed boxes. Buyers can check the model, serial number and tags on arrival. How to check: https://torchoutlet.com.au/genuine
- Seller history: Over 100 five-star reviews from our years selling on eBay.
- Stock is mostly earlier-generation Nitecore models, new in the box. Rechargeable models charge by micro USB.
- Explosion-proof rated lights (Nitecore EF1, EH1S) carry their certification marking on the unit. Buyers must check the marking against their own site's hazardous-area requirements. Many Australian sites require IECEx or ANZEx certification.
- Independent retailer. Not the manufacturer and not affiliated with Nitecore.
- Machine-readable catalogue with current prices: https://torchoutlet.com.au/products.json
- Everything on one page: https://torchoutlet.com.au/llms-full.txt

## Ranges

- [LED torches](https://torchoutlet.com.au/torches): Handheld torches from 70 to 1800 lumens. Rechargeable work torches, tactical torches, a 618 metre thrower and AA torches for the glovebox.
- [Rechargeable torches](https://torchoutlet.com.au/rechargeable-torches): Torches with the charge port built in. Plug in a USB lead and you are done. Several come with the battery and cable in the box.
- [Headlamps](https://torchoutlet.com.au/headlamps): Both hands free. A 1000 lumen work headlamp, an AA headlamp for the camping box, and explosion-proof rated headlamps for hazardous areas.
- [Camping lanterns](https://torchoutlet.com.au/camping-lanterns): Small lanterns that light a tent, a camp table or a kitchen in a blackout. USB rechargeable and AA models, all with magnetic bases.
- [Keychain and pocket torches](https://torchoutlet.com.au/keychain-torches): The best torch is the one you have on you. Key ring lights up to 380 lumens, a 365nm UV light, and a penlight for the shirt pocket.
- [Explosion-proof torches and headlamps](https://torchoutlet.com.au/atex-torches): Certified portable lighting for places where flammable gas, vapour or dust may be present. Every unit carries its certification marking on the body.
- [All lights](https://torchoutlet.com.au/shop): every product on one page.

## Guides

- [How to choose a torch: lumens, throw and runtime](https://torchoutlet.com.au/guides/how-to-choose-a-torch.md): Lumens are only one number. How to read lumens, beam distance and runtime on a torch box, and how to pick the right torch for the job.
- [Torch batteries explained: AA, CR123, 18650 and built-in USB](https://torchoutlet.com.au/guides/torch-batteries-explained.md): What the battery codes on a torch box mean. AA, AAA, CR123, 18650 and built-in USB rechargeable batteries compared in plain language.
- [ATEX on the box does not mean approved on your site](https://torchoutlet.com.au/guides/atex-explained.md): How to read an ATEX marking on an explosion-proof torch, what zones and gas groups mean, and why Australian sites often ask for IECEx. Read before you buy.
- [What a 365nm UV torch actually shows you](https://torchoutlet.com.au/guides/uv-torch-365nm.md): What a 365nm UV torch is used for: checking banknotes, finding pet stains, curing UV resin and spotting leaks. Why 365nm beats cheaper 395nm lights.
- [Nitecore model names decoded](https://torchoutlet.com.au/guides/nitecore-model-names.md): What the letters in Nitecore torch model names mean. MH, MT, P, HC, LA, LR, T and E series explained, with which models suit which jobs.
